Definition
[Difference quotients] 1. ch5:5.8-def-1\group Difference Quotients (i) The $i^{\text{th}}$-difference quotient of size $h$ is \[ D_i^h u(x) = \frac{u(x + he_i) - u(x)}{h} \quad (i = 1, \ldots , n) \] for $x \in V$ and $h \in \R $, $0 < |h| < \dist (V, \partial U)$.

(ii) $D^h u := (D_1^h u, \ldots , D_n^h u)$.
